title: [Main]-"Cannot match item tracking" when partially posting an Inventory Pick for lot-tracked items with Strict Expiration Posting enabled
summary: Fixed an error that occurred when partially posting an Inventory Pick for lot-tracked items with Strict Expiration Posting enabled. The fix filters item tracking validation to only check pick lines with quantities being posted.
key_points: Partial posting of Inventory Picks split by lot now works correctly when Strict Expiration Posting is enabled
Added filter to validate only pick lines with non-zero quantities to handle
Preserves existing lot-mismatch validation for handled lines
Added regression test for the scenario
quote: With Strict Expiration Posting, Create Invt. Pick splits the pick into one line per lot.
